limits: Admission/review only: steering, new vision, worker motion, ally recovery and depletion retargeting may change routes between AI reviews.
Current path checks are conservative: an obsolete cached path can reject a source even when the freshly planned route is safe.
Sample rejection counts include unavailable/ineligible actors and physical failures; they are not an unsafe-path count or a per-frame safety proof.

CanGather proves the ordinary planned route safe; it does not separately assert that a nearest-walkable projected WorkPoint ends within the income admission distance. A terrain-blocked workpoint fixture is an optional further coverage check, not a reproduced regression.
No performance improvement claim: new worker-source route probes can add AI decision cost and need isolated instrumentation.
